snippet.title: Rogue Collector 0.5.0
snippet.description:
https://www.rogue-collector.com/

ROGUE COLLECTOR is a hex-grid tactical roguelike where you don't collect gear: you collect the Rogues. Rescue procedurally generated Rogues from dungeons, extract them in time, or lose them forever. Trade your Rogues on a live player-driven marketplace.
